title: MORE MORE JUMP! Chapter1 Episode3 Make Up Your Mind!

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, sorry for bothering you, um...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh! M-M-M-My name is Minori Hanasato!
Class 1-A, student number 21!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: My favorite hobby is imitating dance choreography, and my special skill is coming up with catchphrases!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Oh no! I got so nervous I introduced myself like I do at auditions!)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Heh. I guess that means we're in the same year. I'm Haruka Kiritani. I just transferred into Class C today.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I was looking for somewhere to read.
Is it all right if I stay here for a while?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: O-Of course!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (I-It's really Haruka! She looks so much smaller in person! But she still has a kind of glow about her!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Wh-Wh-What do I do?! We're actually breathing the same air right now!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (She...looks kind of exhausted...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (I can't blame her. It must have been a rough day with everyone constantly hitting her with questions.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Maybe I should skip dance practice today. It's not easy to read when there's too much noise.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: What were you doing up here, Hanasato?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Me?! I-I was doing some dance practice!
Oh, but not for dance club or anything like that!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I'm hoping to be an idol one day!
J-J-Just like you, Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Huh?
Just tell it to me straight!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Eep! I-It sounds like someone's yelling.

I'm not letting you leave until you talk to me!
Now hurry up, will you?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Sounds like an argument. And it looks like they're heading this way.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Haruka finally found somewhere to relax, and now this?
Talk about bad timing.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
They might not notice us if we hide behind the water tank!
Haru—I mean, Kiritani! This way!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, sure. Huh?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Is that Shizuku?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What? Do you know Hinomori?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I've met her a few times at work before.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, that makes sense! She's the lead of Cheerful*Days, after all! I remember you even did a show together!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I believe the other girl is Airi Momoi from QT. She used to appear on a lot of tv variety shows.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah. Oh, but she quit about six months ago. It's kind of a shame. She seemed pretty popular on those shows.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I chose this school because of the convenience of its credit-based course, but I didn't realize there were so many others in the entertainment business here as well.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I-I suppose you're right, Ms. Kiritani!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Oh my gosh! I can't believe I'm having an actual conversation with Haruka!)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You know, we're in the same grade. There's no need to be so formal. Do you mind if I call you Minori?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
What? Oh, uh... R-Right!
Sure, Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (I-I can't believe my luck! I never thought I'd ever get the chance to actually talk to Haruka! Did I just use up the rest of my lifetime's worth of luck?!)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I wonder what those two are fighting about.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Shizuku, I heard something from an old friend of mine.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: There's a rumor that you haven't been getting along with your group and are thinking of transferring.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Is that true?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Well...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Spit it out already! Being indecisive is the worst thing in our line of work! The fans pick up on it and start to get worried!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I know that. It's just...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I get the feeling this may take a while.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Might as well go out and deal with this now.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Who's there?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: ASRUN's Haruka Kiritani?! You're a student here too?!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Haruka?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hi, Shizuku. Long time, no see. I don't think I've seen you since we recorded together last year.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hey, we're trying to have a private conversation here! What's the big idea trying to eavesdrop?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Eavesdrop? You're the one who assumed nobody was up here and started yelling loudly enough for everyone to hear.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Wha?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Don't worry. I have no intention of telling anyone what I just heard. I may have quit, but I still know when to keep my mouth shut.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Y-You big shot idols always act so high and mighty!
This is exactly why I hate dealing with them!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
...Whatever! As long as you keep this to yourself!
Don't you go blabbing to all your friends, either!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: O-Of course! I-I won't tell anyone!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Good. In that case, you can go now.
We still have things to discuss.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: B-But, um...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: What? You still have something to say?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It's pretty rude to suddenly show up and tell everyone else to leave.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
She was here first, you know.
You're the ones interrupting her dance practice.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Dance practice? By herself? What for?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Well, you see... I'm practicing to become an idol!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You? An idol?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Y-Yes! It's my dream to be an idol!
